You: L-listen, if you really want to become a nun, there sure is a way, right?
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
Sexy nun: …{{wi}}You think so?
You: Sure! You just need to work hard and do… some clergy stuff, I don’t know exactly how to become a nun, sorry.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
Sexy nun: Thanks for cheering me up! I started to think you were some weirdo or something, but you are a nice guy after all!
I think I was just insulted, but HOLY SHIT she said I’m a nice guy! 
Sexy nun: Oh! Oh! I almost forgot! What’s your name? Mine is Shanice.
You: I-I’m Anon! N-nice to meet you.
'Nun' Shanice: Ohhh, your voice is kinda trembling’~ Just chill dude. 
You: Haha… Sorry.
Fuck… After I broke up with my girlfriend I didn’t talk much with real women except maybe my mom, so I'm kind of nervous. 
Since she called me nice my heart started beating faster and I imagined our lives together… I need to calm down really fast or I will fuck this up.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: Oh, right. You talked about some robo-priest. Where is he now?
'Nun' Shanice: Ah, him? He is in the back. If you really want to talk to him I don’t mind calling him over.
'Nun' Shanice: Actually I do mind, but it’s not a big deal.
You: I came here to ask him some questions. You know, new pope and stuff. Few years have passed since the last time I came to church so I wanted to check it out.
'Nun' Shanice: Oh, I TOTALLY get it. First time I came here was to take an IT course, but this stupid can told me that I need to be baptised! 
?!
You need to be baptised for an IT course? And more importantly Shanice is not even baptised and she wants to become a nun?! Oh man, she’s a bigger weirdo than I. {{wi}}By a lot. 
'Nun' Shanice: So I asked him: ‘could you baptise me now’? and then he basically told me to fu-freak off! Man, I’m telling you, he’s such a jerk!
You: Well, I hope you didn’t come with this outfit on! haha
'Nun' Shanice: Yeah, I came here like that. Isn’t that, like, even more christian than some casual clothes? 
You: Well… This is more like a cosplay nun habit. The real one covers legs. Maybe this robo-priest took offence with that? 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
'Nun' Shanice: Are you for real? I thought it’s a summer version or something…
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
